title: 日本文学の世界
subtitle: Introduction of Japanese Literature
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
teachers:
ISHIKAWA Michiko
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn about classical Japanese literature (e.g., narrative, verse, story, chronicles of war).
(2) Improve their reading comprehension skills by reading Japanese literature.
(3) Learn about “Japanese language expression” and improve their ability to think.
advice:
This basic course on Japanese literature will cover the following:

1. Reading classical Japanese literature
2. Composing waka (“Japanese poetry”)
3. Writing critical essays and letters

Students are required to participate actively in class.
Students are expected to bring their textbooks, handouts, and other necessary materials to every class.
Students are expected to learn proper citation methods.
Students are expected to think about their own life through reading classical Japanese literature.
Students are expected to write some waka.
Students are expected to check for message/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class.

Be able to complete assignments according to the rules and submit them by the deadline.

Be able to perform a self-assessment about class goals.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Fully understand the importance of and explain the main points of stories.
(2) Fully understand literary works since the Meiji period.
(3) Use honorific language properly in accordance with
the scene.
(4) Write a formal letter to a superior using the proper format.

*Students are required to write characters correctly on all exams.
